sentences.text:
Through: Ms.Dolly Sharma, Adv.
 versus
 State .....

Re
 Through: Mr.Utkarsh, App for State.

Si Pratibha Yadav, Ps Adars
 Coram:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 19.01.2023 CRL.M.A. 1368/2023 (Exemption) Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.
CRL.M.A. 1367/2023 (Condonation of delay of 28 days) Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice, and fairly does not oppose this application.

For the reasons stated in the application and in the interest of justice, the delay of 28 days is condoned and the application is allowed.
The application is disposed of accordingly.
The present appeal under Section 374 (2) Cr.P.C., 1973 against the judgment dated 23.08.2022 and order on sentence dated 15.10.2022 passed by Ms.Richa Gusain Solanki, ld. ASJ & FTSC (POCSO),
North Distt. Rohini Courts, New Delhi in S.C. No. 561/2017, in FIR No. 273/2017 registered at PS Adarsh Nagar.
The appellant has been convicted under Section 376(2)(f) and 376(2)
(i) of the IPC 1860 and Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

The appellant has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 20 years and a fine of Rs.8,000/- and in case of default of payment of fine, he shall further undergo simple imprisonment for 30 days.
Admit.
